```sql
SELECT
  district,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / pregnancies_registered END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / pregnancies_registered END) * 100.0 AS percentage_point_change
FROM anc_visits
WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)
GROUP BY district;
```
